text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Phew... This beaded bracelet is really 
taking shape. I think that's enough for 
tonight—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ah, no... all the way back 
there...!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'll put it right back for 
you...— Ugh, urgh... I-It won't come 
off...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rescuing the single bead that ended up all 
alone in the gap between the floor and 
furniture proved difficult―― and the 
struggle continued until midnight...
